title: Líder de Fábrica de Software SAP ABAP e BW
description:
Sobre nós

A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.

Líder de Fábrica de Software SAP ABAP e BW

Remoto - Brasil.

Horário - Comercial.

Procuramos profissional experiente para conduzir e desenvolver equipes SAP ABAP e BW. Profissional focado em liderança técnica, governança de entregas e capacitação de times, que será o ponto focal de sustentação e projetos.

Responsabilidades:

  • Mapear competências técnicas e gaps da equipe, identificando planos de desenvolvimento individuais;
  • Promover e estruturar a fábrica de ABAP, definindo processos, padrões e boas práticas;
  • Definir, implantar e acompanhar o programa de capacitação e certificação das equipes;
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento de profissionais em início de carreira e de novos consultores, garantindo ramp-up eficiente;
  • Organizar a cobertura de férias, assegurando continuidade das entregas;
  • Acompanhar e garantir o apontamento correto de horas e conformidade com políticas internas;
  • Apoiar processos de contratação e desligamento de consultores, em alinhamento com RH;
  • Atuar como ponto focal para suporte técnico às equipes de sustentação e para demandas de projetos;
  • Colaborar com a gerência e stakeholders para priorização de demandas e mitigação de riscos técnicos.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em liderança de equipes técnicas SAP ABAP e BW;
  • Habilidade em mapear competências, estruturar equipes e implantar programas de capacitação;
  • Experiência na organização de cobertura de férias, gestão de apontamento de horas e suporte a processos de contratação/desligamento;
  • Boa comunicação com stakeholders e capacidade de atuar como ponto focal entre sustentação e projetos;
  • Excelentes conhecimento técnico em SAP ABAP (PI/PO, BTP, Workflow e Integrações);
  • Experiência prática com SAP BW (modelos, extração/transformação, carregamento e performance);
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis e governança de fábrica de desenvolvimento;
  • Graduação completa.

Qualificações desejáveis:

  • Familiaridade com BASIS;
  • Experiência anterior em estruturação de programas de treinamento/capacitação/bootcamps;
  • Certificações SAP e/ou experiência em projetos de grande porte;
  • Inglês intermediário.

Benefícios:

  • Vale refeição ou Vale alimentação;
  • Plano de saúde extensível a cônjuge e filhos;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Programa de remuneração variável;
  • Auxílio creche - conforme regras sindicais da localidade;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Convênio com farmácias – descontos em medicamentos;
  • Previdência Privada com seguro de vida adicional
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Empréstimo Consignado (após 1 ano de empresa);
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras (Descontos para realização de graduação, pós-graduação, MBA e Idiomas);
  • Política de Subsídios para Pós-graduação, MBAs e Certificações (A Atos apoia o seu desenvolvimento, subsidiando financeiramente ações externas);
  • Speexx (curso online de até 5 idiomas gratuitamente)
  • Programa de treinamentos internos e externos;
  • Universidade corporativa (E-learning com milhares de cursos disponíveis gratuitamente);
  • Espaço Saúde (suporte com atendimento médico - presencial ou online - para os funcionários e seus familiares e contamos também com os programas de bem-estar e qualidade de vida);
  • Terapia online;
  • Programa de acompanhamento à gestante (acompanhamento médico online durante a gestação para colaboradoras ou cônjuges);
  • Programa Minha Nova Parceria de Confiança (para colaboradores e cônjuges. Válido também para filhos adotivos) - Brinde especial + Cartão presente com valor em dinheiro;
  • Day off no seu aniversário;
  • Parceria com a Samsung (descontos na compra de diversos produtos);
  • Bônus de indicação para nossas vagas (conforme política interna);
  • Jubileu (premiação personalizada por tempo de empresa);
  • Accolade (Programa de reconhecimento).

Aviso de Diversidade

Entendemos a diversidade como um fator valioso. Todas as nossas oportunidades são Afirmativas para Pessoas com Deficiência.

Valorizamos a diversidade independentemente de identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, etnia, idade, deficiência, nacionalidade ou qualquer outro aspecto.

Aviso de Proteção de Dados

Os dados pessoais coletados serão utilizados exclusivamente para o processo seletivo e tratados conforme os níveis de segurança adotados pela Atos.

Caso haja alguma dúvida relacionada à proteção de dados ou qualquer aspecto envolvendo o tratamento realizado, você pode entrar em contato por meio do canal: .

title: Desenvolvedor de aplicativos móveis
description:
DESENVOLVEDOR MOBILE SÊNIOR

Principais responsabilidades:

Desenvolver e manter funcionalidades críticas do aplicativo Android em produção

Colaborar na arquitetura e refatoração de componentes legados

Garantir qualidade através de code reviews, testes e análise estática (Detekt, SonarQube)

Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com backend, QA e Product Owners

Participar de discussões técnicas e decisões arquiteturais

Manter documentação técnica atualizada

Requisitos obrigatórios:

Domínio completo da linguagem Kotlin e Java e de boas práticas;

Experiência sólida migrando código Xamarin/C# para Nativo;

MVVM (Model-View-ViewModel), Clean Architecture e separação de responsabilidades (UseCase/Domain layer);

Injeção de dependência com Dagger Hilt;

ViewModel, LiveData, Navigation Component;

Room ou ORMLite para persistência local;

Integração com APIs REST - Retrofit, Ok interceptors;

Experiência prática com CameraX e/ou Camera2 API;

Vivência com ciclos completos de desenvolvimento (feature → release → manutenção);

Git avançado (branches, merge, rebase, resolução de conflitos).

Benefícios:

Plano de Saúde Bradesco para colaborador e dependentes (cônjuge e filhos) cobertura nacional.

Assistência Odontológica

title: Pharmaceutical Retailers and Distributors (Paid Consultancy Opportunity)
description:
Company - RONIN International is an independent B2B market research company specializing in business, healthcare, and tech studies. We are part of the Rippleffect Group (formerly Fat Media Group) and are Company Partners of The Market Research Society (MRS), Corporate Members of ESOMAR, Members of the Insights Association, and Council Members of The Interviewer Quality Control Scheme (IQCS).

About - We are looking for professionals in large pharmacy retailers and distributors for a paid consultancy section.

Qualifications:

  • Responsible for purchasing, procurement, or supply chain decisions within Consumer Healthcare retail and wholesale organizations
  • The purpose of this study is to understand the evolving landscape of trust, regulation, and reputation within the healthcare industry.
  • The paid consultancy session will be conducted as an online survey , lasting around 20 minutes.

Compensation package - BRL R$750 for 20 minutes online survey

title: Tech Lead Machine Learning/Data Engineer
description:
Tech Lead Machine Learning/Data Engineer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Work with a high skilled team to leverage complex and high quality machine learning and statistical models;
  • Implement model to service integration via DAG creations and ETL processes;
  • Evaluate model performance under real data testing results and remodelate accordingly;
  • Build scalable models and DAGs to enable new workflows creations in a high-usage, high-demand environment;
  • Work with worldwide multidisciplinary distributed team, participate in technical discussions and definitions using English as main communication language;
  • Leverage accurate model architecture and documentation.

Essential Skills


  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Physics or related areas;
  • Desire to combine theory and abilities to solve problems pragmatically, applying Machine Learning techniques and integrating them into larger systems;
  • Desire to work with product managers and software engineers, translating requirements into design and models into end-to-end production code;
  • Knowledge in probability and statistical modeling;
  • Hands-on experience in statistical analysis and Machine Learning modeling using Python;
  • Hands-on experience on model evaluation, integration, data transformation and deployment, covering the complete end-to-end cycle;
  • Knowledge in SQL and relational databases;
  • Knowledge with DAG definition and implementation.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Python notebooks, pandas;
  • Experience with PySpark, Airflow;
  • Experience with cloud tools (AWS, Azure, GCP) and orchestration tools;
  • Knowledge about model life cycle, data drift and model drift;
  • Experience with data structures;
  • Experience with finops data treatment and cost saving analysis.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Technical Trainer
description:
Technical Trainer (Consultant) – Latin America

CAS uses intuitive technology, unparalleled scientific content, and unmatched human expertise to help companies create groundbreaking innovations that benefit the world. As the scientific information solutions division of the American Chemical Society, CAS manages the largest curated reservoir of scientific knowledge and, for 119 years, has helped innovators mine, assess, and apply that information to keep businesses thriving. The CAS team is global, diverse, endlessly curious, and strives to make scientific insights accessible to innovators worldwide.

CAS is seeking an independent consultant to deliver technical training and product consulting services for CAS scientific information solutions in Latin America (based in Brazil). This is a contract-based engagement.

The consultant will provide pre- and post-sale technical training and product consulting to users of CAS solutions, including SciFinder, BioFinder, and STNext, with a focus on Life Sciences content.

Services will include:

Training & Enablement

  • Prepare and deliver instructional materials for technical training events, user meetings, and conferences.
  • Conduct on-site and virtual sessions to educate customers on CAS solutions and best practices.
  • Design customized educational content tailored to customer workflows and needs.

Consultative Support

  • Provide product consulting to help customers maximize adoption and value.
  • Collaborate with ACS International teams as needed to align training with strategic objectives.
  • Offer insights on AI-driven features and innovative functionalities within CAS solutions.

Customer Engagement

  • Facilitate onboarding and continuous learning for CAS users.
  • Gather feedback and communicate actionable insights to ACS International for product improvement.
  • Support initiatives that promote customer success and solution optimization.

Strategic Communication

  • Deliver compelling presentations at workshops, seminars, and industry events.
  • Represent CAS at conferences and trade shows as agreed under the engagement.

Required Expertise:

  • Proven experience in designing and delivering technical training programs.
  • Strong ability to simplify and communicate complex scientific concepts.
  • Familiarity with CAS solutions (SciFinder, STNext) and other scientific information platforms.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Skilled in virtual training tools (Teams, Zoom, WebEx) and CRM systems (Salesforce/LEX).

Qualifications:

  • Ph.D. in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Medicinal Chemistry, or a related discipline (preferred focus on drug discovery or pharmaceutical development).
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in technical training, customer success, or product consulting.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English; Spanish proficiency is a plus.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Location & Travel

Based in Brazil; with regional travel within Brazil and across Latin America required up to 20% of the time.

This is an independent consulting engagement. The consultant will be responsible for all taxes, insurance, and business expenses. Duration, deliverables, and compensation will be agreed upon in the consulting contract.

To apply for this consulting position, please submit your cover letter and CV to

title: Account Executive Brazil
description:
Localização

Brasil (remoto)

Disponibilidade para reuniões presenciais estratégicas

Sobre a Cybervision

A Cybervision é uma plataforma moderna de PAM (Privileged Access Management), criada para empresas que precisam de segurança imediata, visibilidade total e controle real sobre acessos privilegiados. Nosso foco é entregar valor rápido, com implantação ágil, monitoramento ativo e abordagem orientada a risco e negócio.

Responsabilidades

• Atuar na abertura de novos clientes no mercado brasileiro, com foco em médias e grandes empresas

• Conduzir o ciclo completo de vendas: prospecção, diagnóstico, apresentação, negociação e fechamento

• Identificar dores reais relacionadas a acessos privilegiados, identidade, compliance e risco operacional

• Trabalhar de forma consultiva, traduzindo conceitos técnicos de cibersegurança em valor de negócio

• Atuar em conjunto com times de pré-vendas e engenharia para construção de propostas técnicas e comerciais

• Desenvolver e manter um pipeline previsível, com foco em resultados e recorrência

• Apoiar a construção da estratégia de entrada e posicionamento da Cybervision no Brasil

• Manter relacionamento próximo com decisores (CIO, CISO, CTO, Segurança, Infra e Risco)

Requisitos Obrigatórios

• Experiência comprovada como Account Executive ou Hunter B2B em tecnologia ou cibersegurança

• Domínio de conceitos de cibersegurança, especialmente:

• PAM (Privileged Access Management)

• IAM / Identity

• Acesso remoto seguro

• Compliance (ISO 27001, LGPD, SOX – diferencial)

• Capacidade de conduzir vendas complexas e consultivas

• Forte habilidade de comunicação com públicos técnicos e executivos

• Perfil hunter, orientado a metas e crescimento

• Autonomia, disciplina e visão estratégica de mercado

• Inglês

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

• Experiência com soluções de PAM, ZTNA, Zero Trust etc…

• Carteira ativa de contatos em TI, Segurança da Informação ou Infraestrutura

• Vivência em vendas de SaaS B2B

O que oferecemos

• Atuação em um produto estratégico e de alto valor no mercado de cibersegurança

• Autonomia real para construir mercado e gerar impacto

• Modelo de remuneração competitivo (fixo + variável)

• Possibilidade de crescimento junto com a expansão da Cybervision no Brasil

• Contato direto com liderança e participação ativa na estratégia da empresa

Perfil que buscamos

  • Buscamos alguém que entenda segurança de verdade, saiba vender valor (não apenas produto) e queira fazer parte da construção de uma nova referência em PAM no Brasil.

title: Analytics, AI and Data Scientist
description:
Remoov is a fast-growing startup that is enabling the circular economy. We are unlocking the value of the $100B used goods industry by removing the friction of upcycling your items, reducing waste by increasing reuse!. We operate in the intersection of tech-enabled operations and sales automation.

Our Stack:

Postgres, Python, Metabase, PostHog, scikit-learn, pandas, numpy, matplotlib, seaborn

Why work with us:

  • Ability to work remotely with a distributed team
  • A small team that loves to learn and experiment
  • Exposure to modern technologies
  • Opportunity to make a real impact in the company’s direction and growth

What we are looking for:

  • Strong foundation of Python
  • Practical knowledge of Git
  • Strong problem solving ability and analytical skills
  • Entrepreneurial spirit
  • Conversational in English
  • We are looking for candidates in Brazil or able to speak Portuguese

Responsibilities:

  • Analyze data and build models to improve the business operations
  • Build dashboards and reports to help the business make data-driven decisions
  • Run A/B testing and data experiments to validate hypothesis
  • Develop data pipeline, statistical modeling, and collaborate on model deployment
  • Design, develop and maintain secure, stable, scalable, and extensible solutions

Compensation Brazilian real 12,000 - 15,000 BRL per month + 0.02% equity in the company.

Looking forward to hearing from you!

title: Account Manager
description:
• LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
  • WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world’s biggest problems?
  • BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world?


Oneday is a VC-backed EdTech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.


We have raised $20M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.


We’re looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.


What you’ll do..

As an Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:

  • Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who’ve already shown interest
  • Understand what they’re building, why it matters, and where they’re stuck
  • Clearly position Oneday’s programs and mentorship
  • Confidently handle objections and guide qualified founders to the next step
  • Book next-step calls and keep your pipeline clean and updated
  • Work in a high-volume environment (150–250 calls/day) while staying sharp
  • Track your performance and continuously improve conversion rates


This is not a passive customer success role.

It’s a performance-driven, ownership-heavy sales role where outcomes matter.


You’ll likely do well here if you:

  • Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)
  • Are comfortable on the phone and can build rapport quickly
  • Think in terms of numbers, conversion rates, and improvement
  • Can stay organised and disciplined in a fast-moving environment
  • Take feedback well and apply it
  • Have strong written and spoken English skills
  • Are resilient, proactive, and take ownership of results


What you’ll get:

  • Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
  • Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis

title: Tech Lead
description:
Na Printi, acreditamos que cada detalhe faz a diferença, mas o que realmente importa é você, independente de sua origem, identidade ou crenças!

Somos uma empresa composta por um time diverso e inclusivo de pessoas #Printers, sempre prontas para transformar ideias em realidade gráfica. Valorizamos a pluralidade e buscamos proporcionar soluções para negócios de todos os tamanhos e segmentos, atendendo de pequenos empreendedores a grandes corporações.

Desde 2012, atuamos no mercado brasileiro com o investimento e a expertise do grupo Cimpress, líder global em customização em massa. Com um portfólio extenso, tecnologia de ponta, preços competitivos e prazos rápidos, oferecemos mais do que produtos: oferecemos confiança, respeito e parcerias duradouras.

Venha fazer parte dessa história de sucesso e inovação, com um ambiente de trabalho e soluções que celebram a diversidade e promovem a igualdade. A Printi é grande e, com você, seremos ainda maiores!

Responsabilidades :

  • Atuar como referência técnica da squad, orientando o time na definição de soluções, revisão de código e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Garantir o andamento das entregas técnicas, organizando prioridades com o time e acompanhando o progresso junto ao PM, antecipando riscos e removendo impedimentos.
  • Colaborar com PMs, Designers e QAs desde a concepção, ajudando a transformar objetivos de produto em decisões técnicas viáveis, claras e sustentáveis.
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento técnico do time, apoiando na mentoria de pessoas desenvolvedoras e fortalecendo a autonomia e consistência da squad.
  • Garantir visibilidade e organização do trabalho técnico, mantendo a documentação essencial e promovendo o compartilhamento de conhecimento.
  • Propor e acompanhar melhorias contínuas de arquitetura, ferramentas e processos que aumentem a qualidade, estabilidade e eficiência do time.

Requisitos :

  • Formação superior em Ciências da Computação, Sistema de Informação, Engenharia de Software, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos como Tech Lead.
  • Vivência em times orientados a produto

Benefícios :

  • Plano médico e odontológico Amil para cuidar de você e sua família;
  • Vale alimentação/refeição, disponibilizado num cartão flexível;
  • Auxilio Home Office;
  • Day off no dia do seu aniversário, para celebrar seu dia especial como merece;
  • Participação nos lucros e resultados;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Total pass, para garantir um estilo de vida saudável e equilibrado, para você e seus dependentes;
  • Vittude: 40% de desconto em sessões de psicoterapia online;
  • Desconto de 20% nos produtos da Printi para você aproveitar.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) SAP BTP CAP
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value

A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! A NTT DATA Business Solutions está há 30 anos no mercado mundial. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por transformação. E queremos transformar o mundo e as pessoas através das soluções que criamos juntos com nossos parceiros. Aqui projetamos, implementamos, gerenciamos e potencializamos continuamente as soluções SAP para fazê-las funcionar para as empresas – e para as pessoas.

Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.

Buscamos um(a) profissional SAP FullStack (Pleno ou Sênior) para atuar em ambientes SAP S/4HANA, com foco em desenvolvimento moderno utilizando o modelo RAP e aplicações Fiori. A posição envolve atuação ponta a ponta, desde a camada de dados e serviços até a interface, colaborando com arquitetos e consultores funcionais em times ágeis ou híbridos.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver soluções SAP FullStack no ambiente S/4HANA.
  • Implementar serviços utilizando o modelo RAP (RESTful ABAP Programming Model).
  • Criar e manter CDS Views (projection, exposure e behavior) e Behavior Definitions.
  • Desenvolver Service Definitions e Service Bindings com exposição via OData V4.
  • Construir aplicações com Fiori Elements.
  • Atuar com ABAP OO seguindo boas práticas de Clean Code e qualidade de código.
  • Realizar revisões de código e aplicar padrões de qualidade e sustentabilidade técnica.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com arquitetos, consultores funcionais e times ágeis.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência prática com SAP S/4HANA.
  • Domínio do modelo RAP.
  • Conhecimento sólido em ABAP Orientado a Objetos.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de atuação em times ágeis ou híbridos.
  • Mentalidade orientada a Clean Code, qualidade e manutenção evolutiva.

Diferenciais (Desejável):

  • Participação em pelo menos uma implementação greenfield de SAP S/4HANA.
  • Experiência com ATC, SCI ou outras ferramentas de qualidade de código.
  • Certificações SAP.
  • Inglês intermediário/ avançado.

Regime de contratação: CLT

100% Remoto no Brasil

Viagens pontoais (2-3 vezes ao ano)

Liberte todo o seu potencial e engenhosidade – molde o seu próprio futuro. Somos mais do que apenas um local de trabalho; somos uma incubadora de talentos. Com diversos caminhos e oportunidades de aprendizado e carreira de longo prazo, oferecemos inúmeras maneiras de realizar seus sonhos.

*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel)

Location: Brazil

Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.

Position Overview:

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions to support the company's mission and goals. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Platform Development: Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel, ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Database Development: Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes
  • API Development and Integration: Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.
  • Security Compliance: Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA, by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.

Additional Responsibilities:

  • Mentor junior developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in the agile development process, contributing to sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.
  • Collaborate with the design team to refine the platform's user interface and experience, implementing responsive and intuitive front-end functionalities using modern JavaScript frameworks.

Competencies/Requirements:

  • Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL. Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git.
  • Experience: At least 5 years of experience in backend development, with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Attention to Detail: A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: NodeJS Developer w/NextJS - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.

What are we looking for?

  • 5+ years of professional experience as Software Developer;
  • 3+ years of professional experience with NodeJS;
  • 2 + years of professional experience with NextJS;
  • Fluency in English (mandatory);
  • Interest in working from Portugal (mandatory).

What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote based in Portugal/on-site.

What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.

Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV!

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.

For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - . The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority –

(please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to criminal convictions and offences.)

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.

What are we looking for?

  • 5+ years of professional experience as Software Developer;
  • 3+ years of professional experience with NodeJS;
  • 2 + years of professional experience with NextJS;
  • Fluency in English (mandatory);
  • Interest in working from Portugal (mandatory).

What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote based in Portugal/on-site.

What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.

Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV!

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.

For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - . The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority –

(please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Analista de Controladoria - Foco em Marketplace
description:
Somos uma empresa especializada em estratégia, operação e crescimento de e-commerces e marketplaces, com forte atuação orientada a dados, tecnologia e performance.

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Controladoria para atuar diretamente na gestão financeira e análise operacional dos nossos clientes, funcionando como uma extensão estratégica da controladoria dentro do ecossistema de marketplaces.

Essa posição exige perfil analítico, organização e afinidade com dados financeiros, combinando atividades operacionais com visão crítica para apoiar decisões e garantir a consistência das informações financeiras.


Responsabilidades

• Realizar conciliações financeiras relacionadas a operações em marketplaces, garantindo consistência entre vendas, repasses e registros financeiros

• Conferir e acompanhar o fechamento financeiro dos clientes, validando informações de receitas, taxas, comissões e movimentações

• Atuar como apoio estratégico na controladoria dos clientes, acompanhando DRE, fluxo financeiro e indicadores de performance

• Trabalhar com conciliação de notas fiscais, conciliação de vendas em marketplaces e validação de repasses financeiros

• Analisar dados financeiros e operacionais para identificar inconsistências, oportunidades de melhoria e ajustes necessários

• Utilizar ferramentas como ERP Bling e sistema Koncili para análise e controle das operações financeiras

• Apoiar o acompanhamento de contas a receber e contas a pagar, sem realizar lançamentos operacionais diretos

• Garantir que os controles financeiros estejam sendo executados corretamente, atuando de forma preventiva e proativa

• Apoiar a estruturação de análises financeiras que contribuam para decisões estratégicas dos clientes e da operação

• Trabalhar de forma integrada com áreas internas, garantindo alinhamento entre operação, financeiro e performance


Requisitos

• Formação superior completa ou em andamento nas áreas de Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou correlatas

• Experiência prévia em rotinas financeiras, controladoria ou conciliação

• Conhecimento em DRE, tesouraria, contas a receber e contas a pagar

• Excel intermediário a avançado

• Perfil analítico, organizado e com atenção a detalhes

• Facilidade para trabalhar com dados financeiros e grande volume de informações


Diferenciais

• Experiência com operações financeiras em marketplaces

• Vivência com ERP Bling ou sistemas de conciliação financeira (ex.: Koncili)

• Experiência em ambientes dinâmicos e orientados a dados

• Perfil proativo e orientado à melhoria contínua


O que oferecemos

• Salário compatível com o mercado (CLT)

• Remuneração variável vinculada ao reconhecimento por metas e resultados

• Ambiente dinâmico, com aprendizado constante e proximidade com decisões estratégicas

• Possibilidade de atuação remota


Modelo de trabalho

• Contratação CLT

• Atuação remota

• Disponibilidade para alinhamentos e reuniões quando necessário

Role: Artificial Intelligence Technical/Solution Architect

Location: LATAM - Remote

Type: Contract

Job Description

  • Strong communication skills and experience in managing various stakeholder relationships to gain consensus on complex technical solutions.
  • Experience in architecting, designing, and implementing solutions on-premises, in the cloud, and using hybrid models.

  • In-depth experience in fine-tuning and customizing pretrained AI models, with good understanding of various patterns and practices in AI, data engineering, and large data processing.
  • Hands-on in Prompt Engineering, Azure Open AI, Form Recognizer, Cognitive Search, Vector Databases.
  • Develop and deliver upskilling sessions to the customer.
  • Python and PySpark

Secondary Skills:

  • MLOps and LLMOps.

title: Coordenador de Planejamento e Análise Financeira
description:
Na Agropalma, há muita coisa boa à sua espera. Então, se você é um profissional apaixonado por aprendizado e gosta de trabalhar em união, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Juntos, alcançaremos nosso objetivos.

Estamos com oportunidades para pessoas com deficiência para todo o grupo.

Descrição Breve do Cargo:

  • Coordenar as atividades de acompanhamento mensal do resultado das empresas (real vs orçado / forecast),
  • Garantindo qualidade das análises e consistência das informações financeiras e o suporte efetivo à tomada de decisão gerencial, identificando desvios, causas e impactos.
  • Coordenar o processo de orçamento anual, assegurando prazos, premissas e alinhamento com a estratégia da empresa.
  • Liderar a elaboração de forecasts periódicos, incluindo revisão de premissas e consolidação das informações das áreas de negócio.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e dashboards claros, consistentes e direcionados à liderança.
  • Atuar como parceiro das áreas operacionais, promovendo entendimento financeiro e suporte às decisões de negócio.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de processos, automação de rotinas e evolução dos indicadores financeiros.
  • Demais atividades conforme solicitação do Gestor Imediato.

Instrução:

  • Ensino Superior Completo Em Contabilidade, Administração ou Áreas afins.

Sobre a Agropalma

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. Atualmente, a companhia conta com seis indústrias de extração de óleo bruto, duas refinarias e um terminal de exportação alfandegado, e emprega cerca de 5 mil colaboradores. A Agropalma também foi pioneira em implementar, há mais de 20 anos, um programa de Agricultura Familiar com palma, que beneficia hoje mais de 300 agricultores parceiros. Guiada pelo compromisso com o planeta e as pessoas, a empresa segue avançando em suas práticas para tornar a palma sustentável uma referência brasileira. Para mais informações, acesse: .

title: Senior NodeJS Developer
description:
Senior Node.js Developer

Location: Brazil (preferred)

Contract / Contract-to-Hire | Immediate Start

We’re looking for a Senior Node.js Developer to join a fast-growing engineering team working on regulated financial platforms across LATAM.

This is an urgent, high-impact hire. You’ll be joining at a critical stage, helping to deliver key product milestones and scale secure, high-availability systems in a regulated environment.

If you enjoy ownership, autonomy, and building systems that genuinely matter - this role is for you.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Building and scaling backend services using Node.js
  • Deploying and managing applications in Kubernetes
  • Working with MongoDB in production environments
  • Contributing to cloud infrastructure (Azure or AWS)
  • Identifying technical risks and proactively solving them
  • Collaborating closely with product and engineering stakeholders

What We’re Looking For

  • 5–8+ years of backend development experience
  • Strong commercial experience with Node.js (essential)
  • Experience with Kubernetes and containerised environments
  • Solid knowledge of MongoDB
  • Experience with Azure or AWS (nice to have)
  • Comfortable working in regulated or high-availability environments

More importantly, we’re looking for someone who:

  • Takes ownership
  • Communicates clearly
  • Thinks ahead and manages risk
  • Works independently
  • Thrives in fast-paced teams

Experience in Financial Services, Open Finance, or Banking is a plus.

title: Analista I de Desenvolvimento de Software | Ruby on Rails
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO :

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Ruby on Rails para integrar nosso time, focado em construir e manter soluções técnicas de alta qualidade. Se você gosta de trabalhar com metodologias ágeis e de criar aplicações escaláveis, essa oportunidade é para você.

Identificar não apenas o bug , mas sua causa raiz, propondo soluções eficazes para mitigar riscos.

  • Desenvolver e realizar a manutenção de aplicações utilizando o framework Ruby on Rails.
  • Criar, manter e evoluir APIs robustas, seguras e escaláveis.
  • Colaborar ativamente com a equipe na definição, desenho e implementação de soluções técnicas eficientes.
  • Participar de ponta a ponta do ciclo de desenvolvimento de software, atuando em um ambiente colaborativo e orientado por metodologias ágeis.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • Experiência prática e comprovada com desenvolvimento no framework Ruby on Rails.
  • Habilidade na construção, manutenção e consumo de APIs.
  • Vivência com modelagem e uso de bancos de dados não relacionais (NoSQL).
  • Experiência em versionamento de código utilizando Git.


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER :

  • Experiência específica com MongoDB.
  • Conhecimento e prática em arquitetura REST.
  • Vivência ou familiaridade com arquitetura de Microsserviços.
  • Boa base em conceitos de arquitetura de software e vivência com frameworks ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Digital Web Experience Solution Architect
description:
Digital Web Experience Solution Architect

São Paulo, Brazil/Buenos Aires, Argentina

Job Description

You were made to do this work: designing new technologies, diving into data, optimizing digital experiences, and constantly developing better, faster ways to get results. You want to be part of a performance culture dedicated to building technology for a purpose that matters. Here, you’ll work in an environment that promotes sustainability, inclusion, wellbeing, and career development while you help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.

In this role, you will:

  • Architect & implement scalable, secure, performant, and resilient approaches for brand websites that meet business and technical requirements.
  • Use modern CMS systems and MACH principles
  • Enable personalization, performance optimization, and measurable business outcomes
  • Comply with CPRA/CCPA, GDPR, and other data privacy and regulatory requirements
  • Manage current state documents including diagrams, operational runbooks, and future-state roadmaps
  • Align digital marketing strategies within the platform architecture and guidelines.
  • Apply principles around people, process, information, and technology to design
  • Collaborate with stakeholders and cross-functional teams to translate business needs into technical specifications and architectural designs.
  • Provide Full-Stack technical leadership and guidance to development teams on modern CMS systems for building dynamic and high-performing sites, ensuring best practices are followed.
  • Continuously evaluate and recommend new tools and technologies to enhance the digital experience.
  • Lead efforts to incorporate compliance features, such as consent management and secure data handling, into the architecture.
  • Collaborate with legal and compliance teams to ensure that architectural designs align with regulatory requirements.
  • Stay current with industry trends in digital experience platforms and architecture, continuously evaluating emerging technologies and best practices to keep our brand experiences cutting-edge.
  • Provide guidance on selecting technologies and tools that also support compliance and data protection.
  • Operational Ownership to ensure uptime and reliability of all brand sites through proactive monitoring, incident management, and performance optimization including incident response and root cause analysis.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve architectural challenges, ensuring that solutions are scalable, secure, and performant.
  • Mentor and support other architects and engineers within the team, fostering a culture of technical excellence and innovation.
  • Provide Legacy Support for existing sites during migration to MACH architecture where needed.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in solution architecture for large-scale, consumer-facing digital experiences.

Required expertise in:

  • Full Stack Development (Frontend: React; Backend: CMS, API-first).
  • Modern CMS solutions (headless and traditional), integration patterns, and best practices.
  • MACH architecture (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless).
  • Cloud ecosystems (Azure or AWS) and cloud-native deployments.
  • Relational database design and optimization; advanced SQL skills.
  • Strong understanding of web technologies, frameworks, and security best practices.
  • Familiarity with containerization, composable architectures, and event-driven design

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience integrating Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) for unified customer profiles and personalization.
  • Knowledge of identity resolution and real-time personalization through event-driven data flows.
  • Exposure to eCommerce systems, personalization engines, or digital marketing technologies.

title: Senior Data Analytics
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de uma pessoa Data Engineer para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas brasileiros. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.

Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!

O profissional será responsável por transformar dados complexos em informações estratégicas. Construir pipelines robustos e escaláveis, garantindo a qualidade e a segurança das informações. E gerar insights que apoiarão a tomada de decisões em várias áreas da empresa, incluindo finanças, clientes e software.


Escopo e responsabilidades

  • Construção de Pipelines (ETL/ELT): Desenvolver e monitorar pipelines escaláveis utilizando Python e ferramentas de orquestração.
  • Suporte ao BI e Analytics: Estruturar visões no Metabase para consultas rápidas e gerenciar a exploração de dados complexos via Looker.
  • Otimização de Performance: Escrever queries SQL avançadas e otimizar o consumo de dados das ferramentas de visualização para reduzir custos e tempo de resposta.
  • Qualidade de Dados: Implementar testes e monitoramento para garantir que as métricas no Looker e Metabase estejam sempre íntegras.



Requisitos Técnicos

  • Python: Experiência em automação, integração de APIs e bibliotecas de manipulação de dados.
  • SQL Avançado: Domínio absoluto de SQL para transformações complexas e otimização de bancos analíticos.
  • Looker: Experiência prática no desenvolvimento de modelos, dimensões, medidas e gerenciamento de projetos dentro do Looker.
  • Metabase: Capacidade de configurar dashboards e perguntas via interface e SQL.
  • Pipelines de Dados: Vivência com orquestradores (Airflow, dbt ou similares).
  • Cloud Data Warehouse: Conhecimento em BigQuery.


Modelo de Contratação: PJ


Oferecemos:

  • Cartão flexível de benefícios;
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados);
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Descanso remunerado;
  • Rotina remota de trabalho;
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.


Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você é uma pessoa Engenheira de Dados Sênior e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora

title: Analista Sr Infraestrutura AWS e Redes (PJ | Remoto)
description:
Modelo de contratação: PJ

Local: 100% Remoto

Sobre a posição

Buscamos um Analista Sênior de Infraestrutura com forte atuação em Cloud (AWS) e ambientes On‑Premise , com conhecimentos sólidos em Segurança de Redes , Firewalls, Middleware e ambientes de missão crítica. Será responsável por suportar ambientes híbridos, aplicações em microsserviços e produtos Cloud‑native, além de atuar na sustentação, deploys, provisionamento e segurança da infraestrutura.

A atuação envolve contato com equipes de Segurança, DevOps e Integração, além de participação em projetos de desmobilização, melhorias de arquitetura e manutenção de ambientes complexos.


Responsabilidades

  • Administrar, manter e evoluir ambientes AWS e On‑Premise .
  • Realizar atividades relacionadas a segurança de redes , incluindo análise, configuração e troubleshooting de firewalls .
  • Suporte e manutenção em ambientes de infraestrutura em conjunto com as equipes internas.
  • Aplicação de patches de segurança , configurações de rede, provisionamento, acessos e governança de ambientes.
  • Suporte e acompanhamento de ambientes com microsserviços (sobretudo em AWS).
  • Realização de deploys, sustentação de ambientes e apoio à fábrica de integração (MuleSoft e Kafka).
  • Administração e suporte a servidores Linux e Windows (predominância Linux).
  • Colaboração com o time de Segurança para demandas de segurança aplicável (patches, controles, ajustes).
  • Interface com o time de DevOps para discussões técnicas.
  • Suporte de segundo nível, contando com apoio do CSC para atividades de N1.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Forte experiência em Infraestrutura AWS (EC2, VPC, Load Balancers, IAM, Security Groups, CloudWatch etc.).
  • Experiência com ambientes On‑Premise (redes, servidores, virtualização).
  • Domínio em Segurança de Redes , incluindo Firewall e boas práticas de segurança.
  • Conhecimentos em Linux (principal) e Windows Server .
  • Conhecimento de Storage , provisionamento, acessos, e governança.
  • Experiência com aplicação de patches de segurança


  • Desejáveis / Diferenciais
  • Experiência com MuleSoft .
  • Entendimento geral de práticas DevOps .
  • Experiência prévia com projetos de desmobilização/mobilização de sistemas , especialmente envolvendo ERPs.

title: Forensic Manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.

Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.

Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.

In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.

To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.

While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.

For more information, please see our

title: Freelancer Analista de Dados de Mídia
description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar em uma função essencial para garantir a qualidade, consistência e integridade dos dados que sustentam as decisões de mídia da marca. É uma vaga para quem gosta de mergulhar em bases, transformar dados brutos em informação útil e conectar análises ao dia a dia operacional do planejamento e da compra de mídia.

Principais Atribuições

  • Monitorar, tratar e consolidar dados das diferentes bases internas que abastecem a operação de mídia.
  • Executar rotinas de extração e manipulação de dados utilizando SQL e ferramentas analíticas.
  • Estruturar informações em Excel de maneira clara, organizada e confiável para uso do time.
  • Realizar a migração manual e o input de dados na Media Tool da Heineken, garantindo precisão e aderência às regras do cliente.
  • Ler e interpretar solicitações do cliente para traduzir necessidades em entregas de dados estruturadas.
  • Conectar informações financeiras, operacionais e de planejamento para garantir coerência entre PI, custos, métricas e investimentos.
  • Apoiar o time na análise de tendências, inconsistências e oportunidades de melhoria nos fluxos de dados.

Requisitos

  • Conhecimento sólido de mídia: PI, custos bruto e líquido, métricas fundamentais, composições de investimento e lógica de planejamento.
  • Experiência com SQL (essencial) e familiaridade com Python para manipulação e tratamento de dados.
  • Sólida habilidade com Excel para consolidações, validações e cruzamentos.
  • Rigor na checagem de informações, atenção a detalhes e comprometimento com a qualidade dos dados.
  • Boa capacidade analítica, organização e clareza para comunicar achados.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência com ferramentas proprietárias ou plataformas internas de anunciantes.
  • Experiência anterior em operações de mídia ou times de Data & Analytics.
  • Familiaridade com processos de QA, automação ou documentação técnica.

title: Desenvolvedor Informix 4GL + Java
description:
O que procuramos?

Desenvolvedor FullStack com sólida experiência em Java, Angular e Informix 4GL, capaz de atuar tanto na evolução de sistemas modernos quanto na manutenção e otimização de aplicações legadas. Procuramos alguém proativo, analítico e colaborativo, com excelente comunicação, comprometimento com prazos e qualidade, e que tenha interesse em contribuir para a modernização tecnológica da empresa.

Atribuições principais:

Desenvolver, manter e otimizar aplicações utilizando Informix 4GL e Java;

Realizar análises técnicas e correções em sistemas legados;

Modelar, consultar e administrar bancos de dados Informix;

Apoiar na definição de soluções técnicas e boas práticas de desenvolvimento;

Participar de integrações entre sistemas e migrações de dados;

Garantir a qualidade, segurança e performance das aplicações;

Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares (negócio, infraestrutura e QA).

Requisitos:

Experiência sólida e comprovada em Informix 4GL;

Domínio em banco de dados Informix (modelagem, tuning, SQL avançado, scripts);

Vivência com análise e correção de sistemas legados de grande porte;

Conhecimentos em integrações via APIs, Shell Script e sistemas Unix/Linux;

Experiência com Java 11+, Spring Boot, Spring Batch e desenvolvimento de APIs REST;

Conhecimentos em Angular 14, Bootstrap e Typescript para front-end;

Experiência com bancos de dados Oracle 12g, MongoDB e Redis;

Familiaridade com práticas de DevOps utilizando Jenkins, Docker, OpenShift e controle de versão com Git/GitLab;

Capacidade de documentar APIs com Swagger 2.0.

Experiência com RabbitMQ, DataDog, Kibana, AWS.

Sabemos que a educação é a chave para muitos futuros possíveis e temos as ferramentas que facilitam o acesso de milhares de brasileiros ao ensino, em vários níveis.

Essa vaga está no nosso modelo de trabalho Gran Mundo , sendo 100% remoto. Dessa forma, você não precisa comparecer ao escritório, apenas em casos eventuais que serão avisados com antecedência e custeados pelo próprio Gran.

Todas as nossas vagas são no modelo de trabalho CLT.

title: Video Editor
description:
About Made Simpler

Made Simpler exists to empower small and medium-sized businesses to grow smarter, stronger, and with real impact. We believe opportunity should not be defined by company size or available resources. With the right system in place, any business can compete, scale, and lead.

We are the world’s first Wholesale Marketing Agency , delivering Managed Marketing as a Service (MMaaS), a powerful combination of strategic human expertise and AI acceleration. Our model provides accessible, scalable, and results-driven marketing and revenue engines, leveling the playing field for growing businesses.

About the role

We are looking for a Video Editor with strong experience in Artificial Intelligence tools , capable of creating highly persuasive videos for Social Media, Ads, and institutional content.

This role requires the ability to balance human storytelling with AI efficiency, producing high-quality, scalable, and performance-driven video content.

This is a full time opportunity, 100% remote.

Key Responsibilities

  • Video editing and assembly: transform raw footage into polished, engaging, and cohesive narratives across multiple platforms, including social media, websites, and advertising.
  • Mastery of video editing tools: work with professional editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, and CapCut Pro (or similar).
  • AI-powered video creation: leverage generative AI platforms to create avatars, videos, and unique visual assets, with a strong focus on tools like Creatify AI.
  • Asset organization and management: maintain efficient organization of files, versions, and workflows using tools such as Notion and Google Drive.
  • Platform optimization: adapt formats, aspect ratios, codecs, and audio levels to maximize performance across platforms like Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and paid ads.

Must haves

  • Proficiency in video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut Pro.
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools applied to video creation and post-production, such as Midjourney, Creatify AI, Nano Banana, Kling 3.0, Google Flow, etc.
  • Strong storytelling ability, with a solid grasp of pacing, persuasion, and visual composition.
  • Technical knowledge of video formats, codecs, compression, color correction/grading, sound design, and motion graphics.
  • Intermediate to advanced English

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.

This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.

To be more specific, you will:

  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.

The ideal profile

We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.

You are someone who:

  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it

You bring strong CM fundamentals:

  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms

You work well with others and think ahead:

  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential

Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.

Next steps in the process ✅

  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!

What’s in it for you

  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!

MoveUp Media

title: Finance Business Partner | Accounts Receivable
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a leading workforce solutions and technology services provider delivering innovative, results-driven solutions to global enterprises. With deep expertise in financial operations, staffing models, and program management, we help organizations optimize performance while maintaining strong compliance and operational excellence. Our finance team plays a critical role in supporting scalable growth, operational efficiency, and exceptional client experiences across diverse programs.

Summary

The Finance Business Partner will lead Pinnacle Group’s Accounts Receivable operations while serving as a strategic advisor to client-facing business teams. This role is approximately 70% operational, overseeing billing, collections, reconciliations, supplier payments, and team performance, and 30% focused on financial partnership and business support. The ideal candidate will bring strong leadership, analytical expertise, and a client-service mindset to improve AR performance and drive financial excellence. This position is instrumental in ensuring accurate cash flow management, client satisfaction, and continuous process improvement.

Job Description

Accounts Receivable Management

  • Oversee the full AR lifecycle including invoicing, collections, reconciliations, dispute resolution, and aging analysis.
  • Ensure accurate and timely billing while resolving client exceptions efficiently.
  • Monitor client payments, oversee cash application, and ensure timely settlement reconciliation to support 100% on-time supplier payment SLAs.
  • Partner with Accounts Payable and Treasury to align receivables with cash flow forecasts and payment schedules.
  • Monitor receivables aging and collaborate with client stakeholders and PMO teams to resolve payment inquiries.
  • Manage quarterly client and supplier volume rebates with precision and compliance.
  • Standardize AR policies, procedures, and playbooks across programs while maintaining audit readiness and strong internal controls.
  • Drive automation and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance AR efficiency and scalability.

Finance Business Partnering

  • Serve as the primary finance liaison to program leaders and account managers, supporting invoice-related issue resolution.
  • Provide actionable insights on billing behaviors, dispute trends, and invoicing challenges to improve program performance.
  • Present tailored AR reporting to leadership, highlighting risks, opportunities, and business impact.
  • Support onboarding of new client programs with structured billing guidance and financial playbooks.
  • Collaborate with Legal and Contracts to align billing terms and resolve disputes effectively.
  • Handle sensitive financial matters with discretion, urgency, and professionalism.

Team Management & Development

  • Lead and mentor a team of 2–4 AR analysts across onshore and offshore locations.
  • Manage hiring, training, workload distribution, and performance management in coordination with leadership.
  • Track and analyze AR KPIs including on-time billing, payment application, supplier payment SLAs, and resolution timelines.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and proactive problem-solving.
  • Design and implement development plans to enhance team autonomy and operational excellence.

Technology & Systems

  • Manage AR modules within Workday and collaborate on system enhancements and integrations.
  • Review testing outcomes for system updates and approve AR-related production releases.
  • Contribute to the AR technology roadmap to support automation and process optimization initiatives.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of management experience in Accounts Receivable or related financial operations.
  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP and accounting principles.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel including pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, and data analysis.
  • Experience with Workday or other ERP/accounting systems.
  • Experience in the staffing industry or Pay-When-Paid programs preferred.
  • Proven leadership experience managing diverse teams and driving measurable performance improvements.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate financial data into business insights.

Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you will play a strategic role in shaping financial operations that directly impact business growth and client success. We foster a collaborative, high-performance culture where innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement are valued. This role offers significant visibility across business leadership, opportunities to influence process transformation, and the ability to build and develop a strong finance team. If you are driven by operational excellence and strategic impact, Pinnacle Group offers a platform to grow your leadership career.

title: Sr DevOps Engineer Azure (Remoto | PJ)
description:
100% Remote

USA Timezone

Contractor / PJ position



Role Overview

The goal is to shape the reliability and scalability of mission-critical platforms on Azure, Kubernetes , and modern DevOps toolchains. You will solve complex infrastructure challenges, automate end-to-end operations, and ensure systems operate with high availability, performance, and security.


What You Will Do

  • Design, build, and improve CI/CD pipelines for applications and infrastructure
  • Develop automation frameworks that reduce manual effort and increase consistency.
  • Configure and optimize cloud infrastructure to align with security, scalability, and performance best practices.
  • Collaborate with development teams to remove deployment blockers and improve delivery workflows.
  • Monitor reliability and performance, identify issues early, and implement data-driven improvements to increase uptime and efficiency.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and drive incident resolution with clear postmortems and preventive actions.
  • Maintain technical documentation for pipelines, configurations, and runbooks.
  • Perform readiness assessments and validation tests before production rollouts.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and ARM templates with version control and reproducibility.
  • Troubleshoot complex deployment, provisioning, and performance issues across multi-cloud and containerized environments.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven track record in SRE or DevOps roles operating production systems
  • Hands-on experience running production workloads on Kubernetes in a cloud environment, including cluster design, autoscaling, upgrades, and network policies.
  • Proven CI/CD delivery using GitHub Actions or Jenkins , including promotion across environments, approvals, and rollback strategies.
  • Infrastructure as Code expertise with Terraform and ARM templates, including modules, remote state, workspaces, and policy enforcement.
  • Strong scripting in PowerShell, Bash, or Python for automation and diagnostics.
  • GitOps experience with Argo CD or Flux , managing multi-environment application delivery and drift remediation.
  • Containerization with Docker and Kubernetes , including health probes, PodDisruptionBudgets, resource quotas, HorizontalPodAutoscaler, and operators.
  • Networking fundamentals with cloud network security practices such as VNet design, NSGs, Private Link, and ingress controllers.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security and compliance, including least privilege, secrets management, audit trails, and control evidence.
  • Excellent written and spoken English .
  • Ability to collaborate across US time zone .


Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Azure certification , such as Developer Associate, Administrator, or DevOps Engineer Expert
  • Observability using Application Insights, Elastic Stack (ELK), Grafana, and Prometheus for metrics, logs, and traces.
  • Experience with log aggregation and alerting at scale using Elastic and Prometheus.
  • Understanding of high availability, scalability, disaster recovery, and cost optimization strategies.
  • Experience managing Windows-based containerized applications .


Plus

  • Experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or AWS

  • Containerization with Docker and Kubernetes , including health probes, PodDisruptionBudgets, resource quotas, HorizontalPodAutoscaler, and operators.
  • Networking fundamentals with cloud network security practices such as VNet design, NSGs, Private Link, and ingress controllers.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security and compliance, including least privilege, secrets management, audit trails, and control evidence.
  • Excellent written and spoken English .
  • Ability to collaborate across US time zone .


Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Azure certification , such as Developer Associate, Administrator, or DevOps Engineer Expert
  • Observability using Application Insights, Elastic Stack (ELK), Grafana, and Prometheus for metrics, logs, and traces.
  • Experience with log aggregation and alerting at scale using Elastic and Prometheus.
  • Understanding of high availability, scalability, disaster recovery, and cost optimization strategies.
  • Experience managing Windows-based containerized applications .


Plus

  • Experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or AWS
