title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Buscamos profissionais para atuar no time de Engenharia de Cloud responsável por desenho, migração, implementação e sustentação de ambientes em nuvem (Azure ou AWS).

Você trabalhará em um contexto altamente automatizado, seguindo padrões corporativos e boas práticas de arquitetura, operações e governança, apoiando a evolução contínua dos ambientes e aplicações.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Migração e Implementação

  • Conduzir migrações de workloads do on-premises para cloud
  • Implementar novas soluções em nuvem desde o desenho até a entrega
  • Criar ambientes base e automatizar provisionamentos

Operação e Sustentação

  • Resposta a incidentes e gestão de problemas em serviços cloud
  • Monitoramento de infraestrutura e aplicações
  • Gestão de patches e manutenções programadas
  • Administração de backup e recuperação
  • Gestão de requisições de mudança (change requests)
  • Otimização de performance e custos
  • Manutenção corretiva/evolutiva e redução de dívida técnica

Plataforma e Integrações

  • Orquestração e gestão de containers (Kubernetes)
  • Manutenção de integrações e APIs
  • Automação de processos e infraestrutura

Colaboração e Governança

  • Seguir padrões e processos corporativos definidos
  • Produzir documentação técnica
  • Compartilhar conhecimento e apoiar profissionais menos experientes

Requisitos e qualificações

Obrigatórios

  • Experiência como Cloud Engineer / Cloud Administrator
  • Experiência sólida em ao menos uma nuvem pública ( Azure ou AWS )
  • Forte conhecimento prático em:
  • Redes e conectividade
  • Segurança em cloud
  • Gestão de identidades e acessos
  • Provisionamento de serviços
  • Experiência comprovada com Terraform (IaC)
  • Conhecimento em práticas DevOps e GitOps
  • Experiência com Kubernetes e serviços gerenciados (AKS/EKS)
  • Programação para automação (preferencialmente Python )
  • Inglês avançado para comunicação profissional
  • Organização, autonomia e priorização de atividades
  • Perfil proativo e colaborativo
  • Capacidade de resolver problemas de forma independente
  • Boa comunicação com times técnicos e de negócio
  • Compromisso com documentação e qualidade
  • Interesse em mentorar e compartilhar conhecimento

Diferenciais

  • Certificações:
  • AWS DevOps Engineer Professional
  • AWS Solutions Architect Professional
  • Azure DevOps Engineer Expert
  • Azure Solutions Architect Expert
  • Experiência com ambientes altamente automatizados e padronizados

title: Conversational AI Engineer
description:
The Conversational AI Engineer is the primary agent builder, responsible for developing and deploying intelligent conversational agents using Google Dialogflow CX. This role owns the conversation layer—from NLU model training and dialog flow implementation through webhook fulfillment and multi-channel deployment. Works shoulder-to-shoulder with the Architect on complex features and consumes RAG/LLM components built by the AI/ML Engineer. Performs preliminary technical testing on all personal deliverables before handoff to the BA for functional validation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement conversational flows, intents, entities, and page/route structures in Dialogflow CX based on user stories and conversation design specifications.
  • Develop webhook fulfillment services in Python or Node.js to handle business logic, API calls, and dynamic responses.
  • Conduct NLU training, testing, and optimization to improve intent recognition accuracy and entity extraction.
  • Integrate generative AI components (built by the AI/ML Engineer) into agent flows—including LLM-powered responses, knowledge retrieval, and summarization features.
  • Deploy and configure agents across channels: web chat, telephony (CCAI), Google Chat, WhatsApp, and custom applications.
  • Design and implement webhook contracts and data schemas between Dialogflow CX agents and n8n workflows (built by the Automation Engineer).
  • Build and maintain n8n workflows for agent fulfillment when scope is straightforward, escalating complex automation to the Automation & Integration Engineer.
  • Implement error handling, fallback strategies, escalation logic, and graceful degradation in agent flows.
  • Perform preliminary technical testing (conversation path testing, webhook validation, intent accuracy checks, regression tests) on all personal deliverables before handoff to the BA.
  • Pair-program with the Architect on complex integrations and participate in code reviews.
  • Manage Dialogflow CX versioning, environment promotion, and agent deployment pipelines.
  • Participate in sprint planning and provide technical estimates for user stories.

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience building conversational AI solutions, chatbots, or voice agents.
  • Strong proficiency with Google Dialogflow CX (flows, pages, routes, webhooks, test cases).
  • Advanced development skills in Python and/or Node.js with experience building and consuming REST APIs.
  • Understanding of NLU concepts: intent classification, entity extraction, context management, slot filling.
  • Familiarity with Google Cloud services: Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Firestore, BigQuery.
  • Experience integrating with enterprise APIs and SaaS platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, Slack).
  • Hands-on experience with n8n (preferred) or comparable automation platforms (Make, Zapier) for building workflows.
  • Proficiency with version control (Git), CI/CD, and agile development practices.
  • Disciplined approach to testing: comfortable writing unit tests, integration tests, and conversation test cases.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Vertex AI Agent Builder or Vertex AI Search and Conversation.
  • Familiarity with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar LLM orchestration frameworks.
  • Experience deploying agents in multilingual environments.
  • Knowledge of speech-to-text and text-to-speech services (Google Cloud Speech APIs).
  • Experience with telephony and contact center integrations.

Estrutura Internacional para Profissionais com Carteira ativa de investidores de alta renda | Remuneração em USD | Modelo High Performance

Selecionamos profissionais com carteira ativa que desejam operar sob uma estrutura global, com liquidez diária em USD e modelo de alta performance.

Top performers (com boa carteira ativa) chegam a US$ 1.000+/dia em comissões.

Estamos expandindo nacionalmente um modelo internacional de alta frequência com hedge automático, em parceria com corretora global multirregulada, com 30+ anos de mercado e presença em 40+ países.

*Não buscamos iniciantes*

Buscamos profissionais com:

  • Carteira ativa ou forte capacidade comprovada de captação
  • Experiência em vendas consultivas (financeiro, câmbio, private, seguros, imóveis de alto padrão)
  • Rotina disciplinada de funil e acompanhamento
  • Mentalidade orientada a resultado

Por que vale a pena:

● Comissões em USD com liquidez diária (PIX/Cripto)

●

title: Gerente de proyecto regional de pagos
description:
El candidato seleccionado deberá:


Liderar la gestión integral del proyecto de alistamiento y preparación de los países miembros del FLAR para su eventual participación en un piloto de interconexión de sistemas de pagos inmediatos, asegurando el cumplimiento de los hitos definidos, la adecuada coordinación con los bancos centrales participantes y otros actores relevantes; así como la correcta articulación de los componentes técnicos, regulatorios, operativos y de flujo comercial.


El candidato seleccionado deberá:


  • Diseñar e implementar el plan de trabajo detallado del proyecto, traduciendo los objetivos estratégicos en planes ejecutables, realizando seguimiento periódico al avance, riesgos, dependencias y posibles desviaciones, y proponiendo acciones correctivas y estrategias de mitigación cuando sea necesario.
  • Conformar y coordinar el equipo de trabajo del proyecto en articulación con las instancias internas relevantes, bancos centrales participantes, contrapartes técnicas y otras institucionales, incluyendo la facilitación de ejercicios de diagnóstico o autoevaluación.
  • Preparar reportes ejecutivos periódicos para la alta dirección; desarrollar presentaciones para comités, mesas regionales y eventos estratégicos, y documentar las decisiones clave, lecciones aprendidas y avances del proyecto.
  • Sistematizar los aprendizajes y buenas prácticas del proyecto para generar insumos técnicos y conceptuales para la Plataforma C3 del FLAR, difundiendo y socializando los resultados en espacios como workshops, webinars y foros cuando sea solicitado.


Requisitos


  • Profesional en economía, ingeniería, administración, finanzas, sistemas, derecho, relaciones internacionales o áreas afines. Deseable, posgrado en gestión de proyectos, innovación, sistemas financieros o transformación digital.
  • Experiencia mínima comprobada de 5 años en la gestión de proyectos complejos y multiactor, preferiblemente en proyectos relacionados con sistemas de pagos, infraestructura financiera o en entornos de bancos centrales, entidades públicas u organismos internacionales, y certificación en gestión de proyectos (PMP® o PRINCE2® Practitioner).
  • Niveles de idiomas mínimos requeridos: español C1, inglés C1, portugués C1.


Conocimientos técnicos

  • Dominio de metodologías formales de gestión de proyectos (PMI, PRINCE2 o enfoques híbridos)
  • Experiencia en el uso de herramientas de planificación y seguimiento (MS Project u otras equivalentes),
  • Conocimiento de sistemas de pagos, pagos inmediatos y/o infraestructura financiera
  • Conocimiento y uso estratégico de herramientas de inteligencia artificial orientado a mejorar la planificación, seguimiento, análisis y reporte del proyecto.


Tipo de contratación


Prestación de servicios, a un (1) año.



Si cumples con los requerimientos del perfil envíanos tu hoja de vida al correo electrónico


Cierre de la convocatoria el 8 de marzo de 2026.

title: Tech Lead Senior Service Now
description:
O que procuramos?

Desenvolver técnicas outros colaboradores, transformando-as numa equipe que gera resultados;

title: Business Intelligence Developer (remote)
description:
A Brunel está apoiando uma consultoria de dados na busca por um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) de BI Pleno para atuar na construção e evolução de soluções analíticas, com forte ênfase em engenharia de dados.

A atuação envolve contato frequente com interlocutores internacionais , por isso o inglês é essencial para o dia a dia (reuniões, alinhamentos e documentação).

O dia a dia inclui desde a modelagem e transformação de dados até a entrega de dashboards e relatórios que suportem a tomada de decisão. A pessoa ideal combina domínio técnico em ferramentas de BI com sólida experiência em SQL e scripting para manipulação de dados em escala.

Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e soluções analíticas em Power BI ou Qlik (Sense/SaaS) .
  • Escrever e otimizar queries complexas em SQL para extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT).
  • Modelar dados dimensionais e relacionais, garantindo performance e escalabilidade das soluções.
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados utilizando scripts em SQL, Python ou outras linguagens pertinentes.
  • Conectar e integrar múltiplas fontes de dados (bancos relacionais, APIs, arquivos flat, data lakes).
  • Documentar processos, modelos de dados e regras de negócio de forma clara e acessível.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (produto, engenharia, negócios) para traduzir necessidades em soluções de dados.
  • Participar de code reviews e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de dados.

Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada (3+ anos) com desenvolvimento de BI e/ou engenharia de dados.
  • Domínio avançado de SQL (CTEs, window functions, otimização de queries, stored procedures).
  • Experiência prática com Power BI (DAX, Power Query/M) e/ou Qlik (script de carga, set analysis).
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados (star schema, snowflake, Data Vault).
  • Experiência com pelo menos um banco de dados relacional (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle ou similar).
  • Familiaridade com conceitos e ferramentas de ETL/ELT.
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente, uso diário em reuniões e comunicação com times internacionais.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Python para manipulação e automação de dados.
  • Vivência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (especialmente Snowflake).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, dbt, Azure Data Factory, SSIS).
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git).
  • Familiaridade com práticas de DataOps e CI/CD aplicadas a dados.

O que oferecemos

  • Trabalho 100% remoto.
  • Contratação PJ com remuneração competitiva.
  • Flexibilidade de horário.
  • Ambiente colaborativo e orientado a dados.
  • Programa de capacitação continuada.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento e atuação em projetos internacionais e desafiadores.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Vue.js / Angular / C#)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Developer with 3+ years of experience with Vue.js, React, or Angular, and 5+ years of C# software development experience, to join the software engineering team for our U.S. client. This key individual should have experience making decisions, leading a small development team, and working both independently and as part of a minor, dynamic team where everything you do makes a difference.

The industry-leading client provides business automation and enterprise resource planning (ERP) software to the oil & gas industry. The client's software and services streamline and automate complex processes, such as revenue distribution, billing, order management, production accounting, accounts payable, contract management, and more, for over 1,700 customers across 9 countries.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate requirements, schedules, and activities; contribute to team meetings; and troubleshoot development and production problems across multiple environments and operating platforms
  • Support and develop other developers, providing advice, coaching, and educational opportunities
  • Define web architectures and solutions from business requirements, produce estimates and timelines, and manage delivery against those plans
  • Exhibit excellent communication skills and engage in technical discussions with peers, becoming a trusted technical advisor
  • Work with others to ensure adherence to code standards and best practices
  • Produce reusable, testable, and efficient code
  • Design and implement low-latency, high-availability, and performant applications
  • Implement secure by design standards, including data protection
  • Integration of data storage solutions
  • Ensure application performance, quality, and responsiveness
  • Collaborate with a team to define, design, and ship new features
  • Identify and correct bottlenecks as well as fix bugs

Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
  • 3+ years of Vue.js OR React.js and Angular experience
  • 5+ years of C# experience
  • Experience with defining service architectures and solutions from business requirements, producing estimates, and managing delivery against those timelines
  • Experience with SQL Server and NoSQL, such as MongoDB
  • Supports and develops other developers by providing advice, coaching, and educational opportunities
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to engage in technical discussions with peers and become a trusted technical advisor. Work with others to ensure code standards and best practices are followed
  • Experience writing reusable, testable, and efficient code
  • Design and implementation of low-latency, high-availability, and performant applications and services
  • Ability to coordinate requirements, schedules, and activities; contributing to team meetings; troubleshooting development and production problems across multiple environments and operating platforms
  • Strong proficiency working in a containerized deployment environment
  • Experience writing well-formed RESTful APIs

Desired Experience

  • Familiarity with the oil & gas industry applications
  • Experience leading a small to medium-sized team, with assistance from outside parties
  • Understanding the nature of asynchronous programming and its quirks and workarounds
  • User authentication and authorization between multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Experience with offline storage, threading, and performance tuning
  • Knack for benchmarking and optimization
  • Integration of multiple data sources and databases into one system
  • Understanding fundamental design principles behind a scalable application
  • Implementing automated testing platforms and unit tests
  • Proficient understanding of code versioning tools such as GitHub

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

  • We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Developer with 3+ years of experience with Vue.js, React, or Angular, and 5+ years of C# software development experience, to join the software engineering team for our U.S. client. This key individual should have experience making decisions, leading a small development team, and working both independently and as part of a minor, dynamic team where everything you do makes a difference.

The industry-leading client provides business automation and enterprise resource planning (ERP) software to the oil & gas industry. The client's software and services streamline and automate complex processes, such as revenue distribution, billing, order management, production accounting, accounts payable, contract management, and more, for over 1,700 customers across 9 countries.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate requirements, schedules, and activities; contribute to team meetings; and troubleshoot development and production problems across multiple environments and operating platforms
  • Support and develop other developers, providing advice, coaching, and educational opportunities
  • Define web architectures and solutions from business requirements, produce estimates and timelines, and manage delivery against those plans
  • Exhibit excellent communication skills and engage in technical discussions with peers, becoming a trusted technical advisor
  • Work with others to ensure adherence to code standards and best practices
  • Produce reusable, testable, and efficient code
  • Design and implement low-latency, high-availability, and performant applications
  • Implement secure by design standards, including data protection
  • Integration of data storage solutions
  • Ensure application performance, quality, and responsiveness
  • Collaborate with a team to define, design, and ship new features
  • Identify and correct bottlenecks as well as fix bugs

Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
  • 3+ years of Vue.js OR React.js and Angular experience
  • 5+ years of C# experience
  • Experience with defining service architectures and solutions from business requirements, producing estimates, and managing delivery against those timelines
  • Experience with SQL Server and NoSQL, such as MongoDB
  • Supports and develops other developers by providing advice, coaching, and educational opportunities
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to engage in technical discussions with peers and become a trusted technical advisor. Work with others to ensure code standards and best practices are followed
  • Experience writing reusable, testable, and efficient code
  • Design and implementation of low-latency, high-availability, and performant applications and services
  • Ability to coordinate requirements, schedules, and activities; contributing to team meetings; troubleshooting development and production problems across multiple environments and operating platforms
  • Strong proficiency working in a containerized deployment environment
  • Experience writing well-formed RESTful APIs

Desired Experience

  • Familiarity with the oil & gas industry applications
  • Experience leading a small to medium-sized team, with assistance from outside parties
  • Understanding the nature of asynchronous programming and its quirks and workarounds
  • User authentication and authorization between multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Experience with offline storage, threading, and performance tuning
  • Knack for benchmarking and optimization
  • Integration of multiple data sources and databases into one system
  • Understanding fundamental design principles behind a scalable application
  • Implementing automated testing platforms and unit tests
  • Proficient understanding of code versioning tools such as GitHub

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

  • We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Adobe Developer (AEM) | Specialist
description:
Você fará parte da Compass UOL, uma empresa global que integra o grupo AI/R Comany ! Atuamos na transformação digital de organizações, ajudando-as a inovar e alcançar resultados de impacto.

Desenvolvemos plataformas digitais e soluções que impulsionam negócios, promovendo eficiência, escalabilidade e experiências diferenciadas.

Com foco em atrair e desenvolver os melhores talentos, criamos oportunidades que transformam vidas e reforçam o papel positivo da tecnologia na sociedade

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções baseadas em Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), com foco em componentes escaláveis e integrações com plataformas digitais do Serasa;
  • Apoiar decisões arquiteturais e garantir aderência às boas práticas recomendadas pela Adobe;
  • Atuar próximo aos times de negócio e tecnologia, assegurando qualidade técnica, performance e estabilidade das entregas;
  • Desenvolver componentes, funcionalidades e integrações utilizando tecnologias relacionadas ao ecossistema AEM;
  • Implementar integrações com APIs REST, garantindo segurança, eficiência e resiliência;
  • Trabalhar com configuração, otimização e boas práticas de cache utilizando Dispatcher;
  • Dar suporte técnico aos times envolvidos, atuando como referência técnica e orientando boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Contribuir para a evolução contínua da plataforma digital, colaborando com squads multidisciplinares;
  • Integrar soluções do ecossistema Adobe, quando aplicável, incluindo Target, Analytics e Adobe Experience Platform (AEP).

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Experiência comprovada com Adobe Experience Manager (AEM);
  • Domínio das linguagens e tecnologias Java, HTML e JavaScript;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de aplicações;
  • Experiência com integrações utilizando APIs REST;
  • Conhecimento em configuração e uso de Dispatcher e estratégias de cache;
  • Conhecimento em Adobe Target (desejável);
  • Conhecimento em Adobe Analytics (desejável);
  • Conhecimento em Adobe Experience Platform – AEP (desejável);
  • Experiência prévia em projetos de grande escala e alta disponibilidade (desejável).

title: Supervisor de Facilities
description:
Requisitos:

Ensino Superior Completo em Administração;

Conhecimento em pacote office;

CNH categoria B.


Responsabilidades:

Elaborar orçamento anual de acordo com os padrões estabelecidos, efetuando a análise de “orçado x realizado” e realizando as justificativas mensais das variações dos gastos, visando o cumprimento às normas e procedimentos internos de orçamento;

Acompanhamento dos Custos e Tendência + justificativa dos desvios;

Apoio na construção de Investimento e aprovação junto a Diretoria;

Acompanhar e interagir nas diversas reuniões de demandas que envolvem a área, reportando e alinhando com a coordenação direta;

Levantamento de Feedback para acompanhar e melhorar o atendimento dentro dos serviços da área.

Garantir a entrega e organização quanto as solicitações de reservas de salas, auditórios e coffee break para todas as áreas.

Supervisionar e garantir as entregas solicitadas pelos clientes dentro do prazo estipulado;

Supervisionar as necessidades de manutenções e reparos, elétrica, hidráulica, ar-condicionado, mobiliário, equipamentos etc., garantindo o acionamento dos reparos necessários com a equipe contratada e/ou chamados com o direcionamento para a área responsável;

Supervisionar os serviços terceirizados como limpeza, portaria, recepção, vigilância e etc.;

Supervisionar e garantir o controle e aquisição dos insumos necessários para atender a unidade (material de escritório, copa e cozinha, limpeza e manutenção);

Supervisionar e acompanhar o andamento e status das obras realizadas na unidade;

Report referente ao andamento e atendimento ao serviço dos contratos críticos;

Receber, supervisionar e dar a tratativa de protestos: com análise de notificações, acionamento das áreas responsáveis e acompanhamento até a resolução;

Acompanhamento e elaboração da nota de débito e rateio de custos entre áreas/unidades;

Atualizar e acompanhar normas e procedimentos internos - Facilities (Sistema / Auditoria);

Apoiar e atuar na implantação de novos procedimentos de trabalho a serem adotados em Facilities.

Atualização em plataforma para tratamento dos requisitos legais;

Renovar licenças e alvarás obrigatórios - IPTU, Alvará de Funcionamento

Supervisionar e aprovar dados no sistema de controle de destinação de resíduo;

Supervisionar e garantir as respostas e tratativas de Auditorias Internas e Externas;

Realizar a gestão operacional do processo de venda de Sucata Metálica e Eletrônica;

Controlar e apurar os indicadores e report dos dados da unidade;

Realizar a gestão da equipe, realizando as avaliações de desempenho, Plano de desenvolvimento, feedbacks e metas.

Controlar o ponto eletrônico (registro de ponto, saldo do Banco de horas e Férias)

Realizar o controle e a distribuição das atividades da equipe, acompanhando de prazo e cronograma, visando assegurar os processos de gestão da equipe;

Gerir os treinamentos disponível para o time e garantir suas execuções. Orientação aos colaboradores admitidos e/ou que necessitem de reciclagem de conceitos, manuseio de equipamentos, ou procedimentos adotados pela área

Atuar na gestão de conflitos, buscando solucionar os problemas no ambiente de trabalho - terceiros e liderados Facilities.


Benefícios:

Vale alimentação ou refeição;

Convênio médico e odontológico;

Participação nos lucros;

title: Analytics Manager
description:
Senior Operations Data Analyst

100% Remote (Brazil-Based) | US-Based Company | Paid in USD/hour

We are hiring for a leading US-based luxury resale and eCommerce company transforming how high-end fashion is bought and sold globally.

We are looking for a Senior Operations Data Analyst with a strong analytics mindset, solid SQL expertise, and proven experience working closely with business teams. This is a high-impact role focused on operational performance, business clarity, and strategic decision-making.

About the Role

You will deliver quantitative insights to support our Operations organization, partnering closely with teams across:

  • Inventory
  • Logistics
  • Retail
  • Customer Service
  • Tech & Finance

This is a business-focused analytics role, not pure research or advanced modeling. The day-to-day work includes:

  • Explaining performance changes (“why did this move?”)
  • Turning open-ended business questions into structured analysis
  • Designing and defining KPIs
  • Measuring operational efficiency across receiving, authentication, launch, and outbound workflows
  • Translating business needs into technical solutions

title: Account Executive
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de uma pessoa para a vaga de Account Executive para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas do Brasil. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.

Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!


Responsabilidades

  • Realizar reuniões com leads qualificados, mapeando dores e oportunidades de negócio
  • Conduzir demonstrações da plataforma e negociações comerciais
  • Elaborar propostas e acompanhar contratos junto ao time jurídico
  • Nutrir relacionamento com potenciais clientes durante o ciclo de vendas
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com SDRs, marketing e produto para feedback contínuo de ICP, pitch e objeções
  • Atualizar CRM com informações precisas e participar das rotinas de forecast
  • Testar e validar novos segmentos, abordagens e ofertas comerciais


Habilidades e conhecimentos desejados

  • Experiência prévia com vendas B2B consultivas (de preferência em SaaS ou tech)
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com escuta ativa e abordagem consultiva
  • Capacidade de entender contexto de negócio e traduzir em propostas de valor
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de CRM como Hubspot, Salesforce, Zoho ou Pipedrive
  • Organização e disciplina no acompanhamento de pipeline
  • Experiência com ciclos de venda curtos e médios
  • Perfil proativo, resiliente e orientado a metas


Desejável

Experiência em legaltech


Modelo de Contratação

PJ


Oferecemos

  • Cartão flexível de benefícios
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados)
  • Day Off de aniversário
  • Descanso remunerado
  • Rotina remota de trabalho
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto


Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você tem perfil comercial, gosta de desafios e quer crescer junto com uma empresa em expansão, se candidate na oportunidade.

title: Account Executive
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de uma pessoa para a vaga de Account Executive para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas do Brasil. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.

Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!


Responsabilidades

  • Realizar reuniões com leads qualificados, mapeando dores e oportunidades de negócio
  • Conduzir demonstrações da plataforma e negociações comerciais
  • Elaborar propostas e acompanhar contratos junto ao time jurídico
  • Nutrir relacionamento com potenciais clientes durante o ciclo de vendas
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com SDRs, marketing e produto para feedback contínuo de ICP, pitch e objeções
  • Atualizar CRM com informações precisas e participar das rotinas de forecast
  • Testar e validar novos segmentos, abordagens e ofertas comerciais


Habilidades e conhecimentos desejados

  • Experiência prévia com vendas B2B consultivas (de preferência em SaaS ou tech)
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com escuta ativa e abordagem consultiva
  • Capacidade de entender contexto de negócio e traduzir em propostas de valor
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de CRM como Hubspot, Salesforce, Zoho ou Pipedrive
  • Organização e disciplina no acompanhamento de pipeline
  • Experiência com ciclos de venda curtos e médios
  • Perfil proativo, resiliente e orientado a metas

title: Agilista Sênior
description:
Somos o Grupo Casas Bahia, com mais de 70 anos de história, realizando os sonhos de +100 milhões de brasileiros.

Aqui, somos protagonistas o tempo todo, sempre com integridade e ética em tudo o que fazemos. A paixão pela nossa gente é o que nos move, e a dedicação total ao cliente é o nosso compromisso diário. Entregamos resultados e buscamos sempre a simplicidade em tudo o que fazemos!

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar no modelo 100% remoto, integrando o time de Tecnologia, com atuação estratégica e operacional, apoiando múltiplos times na evolução contínua das práticas, na melhoria do fluxo de trabalho e na geração de valor para o negócio.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Implementar e escalar o método Kanban em diferentes áreas da empresa, respeitando o contexto e maturidade de cada equipe;
  • Construir e facilitar workshops, treinamentos e sessões práticas sobre Kanban, fluxo contínuo, métricas e melhoria evolutiva;
  • Apoiar líderes e Product Owners na gestão de fluxo, políticas explícitas, limites de WIP e cadência de reuniões;
  • Monitorar e analisar métricas como lead time, throughput, aging e CFD para orientar decisões e melhorias;
  • Atuar como mentor de times ágeis, promovendo autonomia, colaboração e foco em entrega de valor;
  • Conduzir assessments de maturidade e planos de evolução baseados em práticas Lean e Kanban.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência como Scrum Master, Agile Master e/ou Service Delivery Manager atuando com mais de um time simultaneamente;
  • Experiência como Agile Coach, Kanban Coach e/ou Enterprise Agile Coach;
  • Experiência comprovada com o Método Kanban;
  • Experiência prática com Flight Levels;
  • Experiência e domínio de métricas ágeis: lead time, cycle time, throughput, simulação de Monte Carlo, CFD (Cumulative Flow Diagram) e histograma;
  • Experiência na facilitação de treinamentos, workshops, mentorias e cadências/ritos ágeis;
  • Experiência com técnicas e dinâmicas de Product Discovery, Design Thinking, Lean Inception e construção de MVP;
  • Experiência e conhecimento em Power BI;
  • Conhecimento em ServiceNow, Jira e Azure DevOps;
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de métricas como Nave, Power BI e Actionable Agile;
  • Certificações obrigatórias: KMP (KSD + KSI), KCP (KMM + KCP) e FLSA;

Seria muito legal se você tivesse:

  • Certificação em F4P.

Informações adicionais:

Local de Trabalho: Brasil |Remoto.

Confira alguns dos benefícios incríveis que preparamos para garantir seu bem-estar e qualidade de vida:

  • PLR/Bônus : Um reconhecimento extra para valorizar o seu esforço e dedicação!
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica : Para que você tenha toda a segurança e cuidado com a sua saúde e a da sua família.
  • Vale Refeição : Porque sabemos que uma alimentação de qualidade é essencial para o seu dia a dia! ️
  • Seguro de Vida : Tranquilidade e proteção para você e seus entes queridos.

title: IT Service Desk - Advanced English
description:
What a day in the life looks like:

  • Provide frontline support via phone and ticketing systems to resolve software-related issues.
  • Gather key details to assess and triage cases to the appropriate internal teams.
  • Maintain accurate, detailed documentation within the ticketing system.
  • Ensure timely responses and resolutions in line with defined SLAs.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, vendors, and partners to drive case resolution.
  • Use empathy, active listening, and emotional intelligence to ensure excellent customer experiences.

What you bring to the team:

  • BA/BS Degree, Computer Science, MIS, or equivalent.
  • 3 years of technical customer support experience.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication in English.
  • Experience or industry knowledge in supply chain software such as warehouse management solutions or order/ inventory management solutions.
  • Experience in database (SQL / Oracle) queries and stored procedures.
  • Experience with operating systems and RF hardware.
  • Experience with labeling software (e.g., Bartender) and voice solutions such as Honeywell is a plus.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow or other industry-standard ticketing systems is preferred.
  • Fluency in English. Mandatory

You Are Skilled With And Have Significant Experience With

  • Supply chain and distribution industry knowledge and experience.
  • Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) expertise in RedPrairie (JDA), Manhattan Associates, SAP- WM, Oracle-WM, Accellos, Infor, etc.
  • Barcode scanning and RF hardware (Intermec, LXE, Motorola, Symbol)
  • Labeling (Bartender or Loftware) experience a plus
  • Reporting (Cognos, Business Objects, SSRS) experience a plus
  • Networking (Cisco, WAN/LAN, troubleshooting)

Why join us?

At Infios, we're not just looking for employees; we're looking for partners in innovation, growth, and purpose. Meeting you where you are to create the future you need is at the core of who we are and what we do. Whether you're at the beginning of your career or a seasoned expert, we meet you on your journey, equipping you with the tools and opportunities to build the future you envision. Together, we will relentlessly work toward one common goal - making supply chains better.

We believe the future is better when supply chains work better.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Who We Are

MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry.

We’re excited to be hiring a Talent Acquisition Specialist to help grow MAVI’s talent network from the hundreds today to millions in the years ahead. Talent acquisition is at the heart of MAVI’s platform, and we’re looking for someone who is creative, resourceful, and data-driven to help us build scalable ways of sourcing and vetting top finance talent across the globe.

You’ll be joining as one of the first dedicated members of our Talent Acquisition (TA) team, working closely with colleagues and founders to shape and expand our network. This is a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact, build processes from the ground up, and directly influence how we grow.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead and support end-to-end talent acquisition.
  • Explore, establish, and refine channels for talent sourcing at scale across LATAM (primarily), APAC, and other regions, in close partnership with the engineering team.
  • Build proprietary sourcing networks in key regions, using creative strategies to attract exceptional talent.
  • Guide and improve the vetting process to ensure only the most qualified finance & accounting professionals join MAVI’s network.
  • Define and track key performance metrics for sourcing and vetting to continuously enhance processes and uphold high standards of quality.
  • Collaborate closely with the TA team, founders, and engineering team to introduce automation and efficiencies across sourcing, screening, and vetting.
  • Partner with the TA team and founders to shape the right distribution of skills and profiles in the talent pool, and source accordingly to meet these goals.
  • Consistently work towards meeting and surpassing monthly talent acquisition KPIs.
  • Act as a trusted thought partner to the founders on all aspects of talent acquisition.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 3-8+ years of end-to-end recruiting experience, with some leadership exposure being a plus.
  • Strong ability to source high-quality talent at scale using both active and passive techniques, ideally across multiple regions (with APAC and LATAM experience being especially valuable).
  • Skilled in vetting and interviewing talent, serving as an early filter to assess candidates against defined criteria.
  • Experience experimenting with and refining different sourcing channels and strategies.
  • Comfortable using data to guide sourcing and acquisition decisions, and setting KPIs to measure success.
  • Prior experience recruiting finance & accounting talent is a plus, though not essential.
  • Familiarity with key HR tools (e.g., LinkedIn, job boards, ATS platforms) to support efficient acquisition processes.
  • Ability to thrive in dynamic, fast-moving environments, with flexibility to adapt to change.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • A team player who is humble, driven, and passionate about delivering excellence in their work.

Why You Should Join Us:

  • Impact : You’re not just another cog in the machine; you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business.
  • No Bureaucracy : Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness.
  • Competitive Pay : We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it.
  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

At MAVI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and life experience. Employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: MS D365 CRM Functional Consultant
description:
We never request payment at any stage of our recruitment process, and we only contact candidates through official corporate accounts and platforms. If you are approached with any request for payment, it is likely fraudulent. Please verify whether the role you are interested in is posted on our official website.

About TMF Group

TMF Group is a leading global provider of high-value business services to clients operating and investing worldwide. We deliver specialized, business‑critical financial and administrative services that enable our clients to operate their corporate structures, finance vehicles and investment funds across multiple jurisdictions.

Discover the Role

We are seeking a CRM Business Analyst / CRM Functional Consultant who will play a key role in gathering business requirements and supporting implementations of Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) . The ideal candidate is resourceful, detail‑oriented, self‑driven and committed to deeply understanding business needs and translating them into effective technical solutions.

Strong listening skills, collaboration, openness to feedback and a sense of ownership are essential to success in this role. If you are driven by challenge, enjoy going the extra mile and want to work with highly talented professionals, this is the opportunity for you.

If you are an experienced Microsoft D365 CRM Functional Consultant seeking dynamic projects and a collaborative team, we encourage you to apply.

Key Responsibilities

  • Gather and document business requirements in collaboration with stakeholders.
  • Implement Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions tailored to business needs.
  • Configure and customize D365 CRM to meet functional requirements.
  • Work closely with technical teams to integrate CRM with other systems.
  • Participate in project planning, estimating and project management activities.
  • Deliver end‑user training and provide ongoing functional support.
  • Maintain up‑to‑date knowledge of new D365 CRM features and capabilities.
  • Mentor and guide junior consultants when needed.

Key Requirements

  • Experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM implementation and customization.
  • Experience with version 8.0 or later.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Experience developing custom workflows, entities and plugins using C# or .NET .
  • Strong understanding of D365 CRM’s data model, security model and configuration options.
  • Excellent analytical, problem‑solving and critical‑thinking skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently or in a team environment.

What’s in It for You?

Career Development

  • Opportunities for internal mobility and career progression.
  • Collaboration with global colleagues and exposure to international clients.
  • Continuous learning supported by the TMF Business Academy .

Making an Impact

  • Direct contribution to simplifying global business operations for our clients.
  • Opportunities to support local communities through our corporate social responsibility initiatives.

A Supportive Environment

  • A strong feedback culture that supports growth and engagement.
  • Flexibility to work from our offices or remotely, promoting work‑life balance.
  • An inclusive environment where people are empowered and encouraged to grow their careers.

At TMF Group, our people define who we are . We thrive on entrepreneurial spirit and value proactive professionals who bring passion, accountability and excellence to everything they do.

TMF Group is a leading global provider of high-value business services to clients operating and investing worldwide. We deliver specialized, business‑critical financial and administrative services that enable our clients to operate their corporate structures, finance vehicles and investment funds across multiple jurisdictions.

Discover the Role

We are seeking a CRM Business Analyst / CRM Functional Consultant who will play a key role in gathering business requirements and supporting implementations of Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) . The ideal candidate is resourceful, detail‑oriented, self‑driven and committed to deeply understanding business needs and translating them into effective technical solutions.

Strong listening skills, collaboration, openness to feedback and a sense of ownership are essential to success in this role. If you are driven by challenge, enjoy going the extra mile and want to work with highly talented professionals, this is the opportunity for you.

If you are an experienced Microsoft D365 CRM Functional Consultant seeking dynamic projects and a collaborative team, we encourage you to apply.

Key Responsibilities

  • Gather and document business requirements in collaboration with stakeholders.
  • Implement Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions tailored to business needs.
  • Configure and customize D365 CRM to meet functional requirements.
  • Work closely with technical teams to integrate CRM with other systems.
  • Participate in project planning, estimating and project management activities.
  • Deliver end‑user training and provide ongoing functional support.
  • Maintain up‑to‑date knowledge of new D365 CRM features and capabilities.
  • Mentor and guide junior consultants when needed.

Key Requirements

  • Experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM implementation and customization.
  • Experience with version 8.0 or later.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Experience developing custom workflows, entities and plugins using C# or .NET .
  • Strong understanding of D365 CRM’s data model, security model and configuration options.
  • Excellent analytical, problem‑solving and critical‑thinking skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently or in a team environment.

What’s in It for You?

Career Development

  • Opportunities for internal mobility and career progression.
  • Collaboration with global colleagues and exposure to international clients.
  • Continuous learning supported by the TMF Business Academy .

Making an Impact

  • Direct contribution to simplifying global business operations for our clients.
  • Opportunities to support local communities through our corporate social responsibility initiatives.

A Supportive Environment

  • A strong feedback culture that supports growth and engagement.
  • Flexibility to work from our offices or remotely, promoting work‑life balance.
  • An inclusive environment where people are empowered and encouraged to grow their careers.

At TMF Group, our people define who we are . We thrive on entrepreneurial spirit and value proactive professionals who bring passion, accountability and excellence to everything they do.

title: Customer Support Specialist (German Desk)
description:
Genesis is a full-service international IT company. More than 1,500 people in five countries create products for more than 200 million unique monthly users. We are one of the largest partners of Facebook, Google, Snapchat, and Apple in Eastern Europe. Our ecosystem consists of more than 15 companies and an investment fund.

EverHelp is a company in the Genesis ecosystem. We’re a team of professionals, that’s developing outsourcing support services for plenty of products all over the world at a dynamic tempo. The project launched in 2021, and we've experienced a yearly growth rate of +82%. Since February 2022, we've managed to preserve all our workplaces and, most importantly, we continue to strengthen our team while maintaining an employee satisfaction rate of over 90%.

The vacancy is open due to the start of cooperation with a new client in the FoodTech domain.

To support the client’s customers across multiple channels and ensure consistently high service quality, we are expanding the support team and looking for a Customer Support Representative with strong English and German communication skills.

Role Mission

To provide fast, accurate, and customer-oriented support for the client’s users by handling requests via tickets and chat, ensuring high CSAT, meeting SLA targets, and maintaining consistent service quality in daily operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Handle customer inquiries via tickets and chat in German and English.
  • Provide clear, structured, and empathetic responses while following internal processes and guidelines.
  • Maintain a high service quality level and consistently meet SLA requirements (FRT and Time to Close).
  • Resolve typical customer issues independently and escalate more complex cases when needed.
  • Work with multiple support tools and internal documentation to ensure correct case handling.
  • Contribute to maintaining and improving internal documentation and support workflows.
  • Ensure accurate communication and attention to detail in customer-facing messages.

Working schedule:

  • Monday–Friday
  • 12:00 AM – 8:00 AM CET
  • Break included

About You:

  • 2+ years of experience in Customer Support (chat/tickets).
  • German and English at C1/C2 level (written and spoken).
  • Strong written communication skills: clear structure, literacy, and attention to detail.
  • Fast typing and confidence working in a high-load environment.
  • Basic Excel / Google Sheets skills.
  • Strong information search skills and ability to work with documentation.
  • Ability to stay calm under pressure and handle urgent requests professionally.
  • High responsibility and reliability (SLA-driven role).
  • Empathy and strong customer focus, especially in complaint handling.

Work with EverHelp is about:

  • Opportunity to join a new client project from the early stage and contribute to building stable support operations.
  • Work in a dynamic environment with international customers and daily real-life problem solving.
  • Professional growth in customer communication, conflict resolution, and working with CRM/support tools.
  • Clear performance expectations and measurable KPIs (CSAT, FRT, Time to Close).
  • Fully remote work.
  • 20 days of paid vacation.
  • 10 paid sick leave days (with confirmation).
  • Well-being bonus
  • Paid training.
  • Stable collaboration format and transparent processes.

title: Brazil - Remote: Data Engineer - Platform & Pipelines
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties

We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.

You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from \"Bronze\" (Raw) to \"Silver\" (Cleaned) and \"Gold\" (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.

What You’ll Do

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
  • Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
  • Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time; make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
  • Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
  • Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.

The Technology Stack

  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
  • Data Processing: Polars (primary for ETL), PySpark/SQL (for massive scale)
  • Compute : Single-node workers (Polars), Databricks/Spark clustrers (when scale requires)
  • Storage: Delta Lake, Parquet, S3/Blob Storage, MinIO
  • Language: Python 3.12+ (w/ Polars), SQL.


Qualifications


Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in Apache Airflow and Databricks .
  • Experience implementing Medallion/Delta Lake architectures.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills.
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Experience with Unity Catalog or other governance tools.
  • Familiarity with dbt (data build tool).
  • Background in processing telemetry or sensor data.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • The Structured Thinker: You love organizing data. You understand the importance of schemas, data typing, and normalization.
  • Quality Obsessive: You don't just move data; you test it. You implement checks to ensure no bad data reaches the Gold layer.
  • Pipeline Builder: You view data engineering as software engineering. You write modular, reusable code for your transformations.

title: Brazil - Remote: Data Engineer - Platform & Pipelines
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties

We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.

You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from \"Bronze\" (Raw) to \"Silver\" (Cleaned) and \"Gold\" (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.

What You’ll Do

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
  • Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
  • Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time; make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
  • Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
  • Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.

The Technology Stack

  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
  • Data Processing: Polars (primary for ETL), PySpark/SQL (for massive scale)
  • Compute : Single-node workers (Polars), Databricks/Spark clustrers (when scale requires)
  • Storage: Delta Lake, Parquet, S3/Blob Storage, MinIO
  • Language: Python 3.12+ (w/ Polars), SQL.


Qualifications


Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in Apache Airflow and Databricks .
  • Experience implementing Medallion/Delta Lake architectures.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills.
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Experience with Unity Catalog or other governance tools.
  • Familiarity with dbt (data build tool).
  • Background in processing telemetry or sensor data.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • The Structured Thinker: You love organizing data. You understand the importance of schemas, data typing, and normalization.
  • Quality Obsessive: You don't just move data; you test it. You implement checks to ensure no bad data reaches the Gold layer.
  • Pipeline Builder: You view data engineering as software engineering. You write modular, reusable code for your transformations.

title: Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer
description:
Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer


Location: Brazil (Remote)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

Our trusted high-growth technology partner is building a production AI platform that transforms disconnected data into measurable business growth. With customers already onboarding and the platform live in production, they are hiring a Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer to scale their next-generation AI systems.



Position Overview:


We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer to own the intersection of agentic AI and modern web development . You will build the intelligent backend powering a multi-agent system and the interactive frontend delivering real-time AI experiences . This role requires strong architectural judgment — the platform runs on Vercel , and decisions around caching, bandwidth, cost efficiency, and production reliability are critical.

If you are excited about building AI agents that work in production , designing streaming chat experiences , and solving complex orchestration challenges , this is the opportunity for you.



What You'll Do:


  • Design and optimize production prompts for LLMs and build multi-agent workflows with smart routing, specialization, and human-in-the-loop approval gates
  • Build stateful agent workflows with planning, execution, and observation loops — making sure agents reliably follow structured steps even when users go off-script
  • Create streaming chat UIs with real-time rendering, tool call visualization, and interactive artifacts
  • Connect agents to analytical databases for live data retrieval, SQL generation, and knowledge base access through RAG pipelines
  • Own performance across the full stack — caching strategies, bandwidth optimization, and keeping Vercel costs under control
  • Implement LLMOps practices including prompt versioning, observability, and cost tracking.



What You Bring


  • 3–5+ years of progressive experience in full-stack development.
  • Strong TypeScript skills across frontend, backend, and agent logic
  • Production experience with React or Next.js (App Router, Server Components, API routes)
  • Hands-on work with LLM agent frameworks — LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or custom agent loops
  • Production prompt engineering: system prompts, chain-of-thought reasoning, tool-calling patterns
  • Direct experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models)
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience



Nice to Have

  • Experience with Vercel AI SDK (useChat, streamText, streaming patterns)
  • Familiarity with durable workflow engines like Trigger.dev or Temporal
  • Experience with RAG pipelines, vector databases, or knowledge retrieval systems
  • Background in performance optimization for Vercel-hosted applications
  • Experience at an early-stage startup or building a product from 0 to 1.



Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

  • Build stateful agent workflows with planning, execution, and observation loops — making sure agents reliably follow structured steps even when users go off-script
  • Create streaming chat UIs with real-time rendering, tool call visualization, and interactive artifacts
  • Connect agents to analytical databases for live data retrieval, SQL generation, and knowledge base access through RAG pipelines
  • Own performance across the full stack — caching strategies, bandwidth optimization, and keeping Vercel costs under control
  • Implement LLMOps practices including prompt versioning, observability, and cost tracking.



What You Bring


  • 3–5+ years of progressive experience in full-stack development.
  • Strong TypeScript skills across frontend, backend, and agent logic
  • Production experience with React or Next.js (App Router, Server Components, API routes)
  • Hands-on work with LLM agent frameworks — LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or custom agent loops
  • Production prompt engineering: system prompts, chain-of-thought reasoning, tool-calling patterns
  • Direct experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models)
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience



Nice to Have

  • Experience with Vercel AI SDK (useChat, streamText, streaming patterns)
  • Familiarity with durable workflow engines like Trigger.dev or Temporal
  • Experience with RAG pipelines, vector databases, or knowledge retrieval systems
  • Background in performance optimization for Vercel-hosted applications
  • Experience at an early-stage startup or building a product from 0 to 1.



Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .

Necessário:

  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Especialista de Negócios em Geotecnologias
description:
Descrição da vaga

Buscamos um profissional sênior e estratégico para atuar na identificação e desenvolvimento de novas oportunidades de negócio, com foco em soluções inovadoras para processos críticos dos nossos clientes e na temática ESG. Se você tem paixão por transformar desafios de mercado em propostas de valor baseadas no uso de geotecnologias, inteligência artifical e analytics, e possui experiência comprovada no ciclo de desenvolvimento de negócios, do insight estratégico à execução das vendas, esta é a sua oportunidade de atuar em uma empresa que usa a tecnologia para transformar negócios e a sociedade.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

O profissional que aceitar esse desafio será responsável por:

Identificar novas oportunidades estratégicas de crescimento, desenvolver e refinar propostas de valor claras e diferenciadas para entrada em novos segmentos e expansão na nossa base de clientes.

Estruturar e posicionar soluções que enderecem de forma eficaz as demandas e necessidades complexas dos clientes,

Definir tecnicamente a arquitetura e a estrutura das soluções propostas, garantindo alinhamento com a necessidade de negócio do cliente e a viabilidade técnica.

Atuar como interface estratégica com áreas técnicas (Arquitetura e Soluções) para a validação, refinamento e garantia da entrega das soluções e garantindo p engajamento necessário em negociações complexas de serviços que envolvam customizações e/ou integrações.

Realizar o acompanhamento contínuo de tendências tecnológicas, inovações e movimentos do mercado para antecipar necessidades e adaptar o portfólio de soluções.

Apoiar a execução da estratégia de vendas e a evolução do pipeline de oportunidades, produzindo documentos de visão e propostas que sejam aderentes aos problemas de negócio, orçamentos e prazos dos cliente e gerenciando o ciclo de vida do funil, desde a prospecção até o fechamento.

Realizar, no papel de um especialista em tecnologia, apresentações sobre a plataforma Esri e soluções de seus parceiros para clientes e em eventos para o mercado, reforçando a proposta de valor da Imagem.



Requisitos e Qualificações

Experiência Sólida em funções de Business Development, Pré-Vendas, Consultoria Estratégica ou Arquitetura de Soluções, preferencialmente em um contexto B2B e B2G.

Profundo conhecimento e habilidade comprovada em estruturar propostas de valor, modelos de negócio e ofertas técnicas complexas.

Capacidade analítica e estratégica para identificar tendências, analisar dados de mercado e traduzi-los em planos de ação e oportunidades de negócio tangíveis.

Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e negociação, com capacidade de interagir e influenciar executivos e áreas técnicas.

title: Especialista de Negócios em Geotecnologias

Se você tem paixão por transformar desafios de mercado em propostas de valor baseadas no uso de geotecnologias, inteligência artifical e analytics, e possui experiência comprovada no ciclo de desenvolvimento de negócios, do insight estratégico à execução das vendas, esta é a sua oportunidade de atuar em uma empresa que usa a tecnologia para transformar negócios e a sociedade.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

O profissional que aceitar esse desafio será responsável por:

Identificar novas oportunidades estratégicas de crescimento, desenvolver e refinar propostas de valor claras e diferenciadas para entrada em novos segmentos e expansão na nossa base de clientes.

Estruturar e posicionar soluções que enderecem de forma eficaz as demandas e necessidades complexas dos clientes,

Definir tecnicamente a arquitetura e a estrutura das soluções propostas, garantindo alinhamento com a necessidade de negócio do cliente e a viabilidade técnica.

Atuar como interface estratégica com áreas técnicas (Arquitetura e Soluções) para a validação, refinamento e garantia da entrega das soluções e garantindo p engajamento necessário em negociações complexas de serviços que envolvam customizações e/ou integrações.

Realizar o acompanhamento contínuo de tendências tecnológicas, inovações e movimentos do mercado para antecipar necessidades e adaptar o portfólio de soluções.

title: Digital Experience Solution Architect
description:
Join Toptal’s Elite Network of Freelance Talent

Toptal is an exclusive network of the world’s top freelance software developers, designers, finance experts, product managers, and project managers. As one of the fastest-growing fully remote networks globally, we empower professionals to thrive in their freelance careers while working with leading companies around the world.

About the Client

Our client is a global consumer goods leader dedicated to developing essential products, with a strong focus on innovation, sustainability, and responsible manufacturing.

Role: Digital Experience Solution Architect

Seeking an experienced Digital Experience Architect to lead the design and implementation of secure, scalable, and high-performing brand websites. This role drives technical strategy, personalization, and compliance across digital platforms while mentoring teams and fostering innovation.

About the Role

This is a high-impact role within a global consumer goods company, focused on modernizing digital brand experiences through MACH architecture and cloud-native solutions. The digital team is transitioning legacy platforms to composable, API-first environments to improve speed, performance, and personalization. Collaboration across marketing, legal, compliance, and engineering functions is essential to align technical architecture with business goals and regulatory standards. The team prioritizes innovation, sustainability, and inclusivity, with strong support for career development and hybrid work flexibility.

Task and Deliverables

  • Architect and implement scalable, secure digital solutions for global brand websites
  • Lead the transition to modern CMS systems using MACH principles (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless)
  • Integrate personalization tools and performance optimization techniques to drive measurable business outcomes
  • Ensure compliance with global privacy regulations (CPRA/CCPA, GDPR) and lead consent and data protection architecture
  • Maintain architectural documentation including roadmaps, runbooks, and system diagrams.
  • Provide full-stack technical leadership across frontend (React) and backend systems
  • Guide teams on technology selection, architecture best practices, and compliance integration
  • Ensure uptime and reliability through proactive monitoring, incident response, and root cause analysis
  • Mentor team members, fostering a culture of technical excellence
  • Support legacy systems during phased migration to modern architecture

Requirements

Must Have:

  • 8+ years of experience in solution architecture for large-scale, consumer-facing digital platforms
  • Expertise in full-stack development (React frontend, CMS/backend, API-first integration)
  • Strong knowledge of MACH architecture and modern CMS platforms (headless and traditional)
  • Experience with Azure or AWS and cloud-native deployments
  • Strong understanding of relational databases, SQL, and web security best practices
  • Familiarity with containerization, composable architectures, and event-driven design

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) and real-time personalization
  • Knowledge of identity resolution and event-based customer interaction flows
  • Exposure to eCommerce platforms and digital marketing technologies

Additional Details

  • Location: Remote in Brazil or Argentina
  • Type: 40h/week Contract
  • Duration: 6–12 months (with possibility of extension)
  • Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in their country of residence without employer sponsorship
